Thanks for the quick demo last week. Finance is moving forward with vendor provisioning but I need to collect documentation before our AP team can create a supplier record and enable PO routing. Can you confirm the following for Redwood?

I attached our preferred PO template for reference and included a scanned copy of our VAT/TIN request form. If possible, please return Redwood's VAT cert and a sample invoice PDF so we can complete the supplier record this week.

Thanks — aiming to turn on PO routing by EOD Monday if all docs are present.

Quick answers for AP:
- We require the PO number to be present on the invoice header; if it's missing we will route for manual match which delays payment.
- We support split invoices against a single PO (we accept multiple invoice lines or separate invoices referencing the same PO). Please let us know if you need line-level delivery IDs — we can include them in the invoice XML/CSV export.
- Remittance instructions: bank details must match vendor record metadata (we include IBAN + SWIFT).

Note: Redwood's tax footprint for EU customers is handled via our subsidiary Redwood EU Services S.à r.l. (VAT: LU12345678). For US-sourced invoices we will include the US EIN. I've attached our VAT cert and a sample invoice exported from our billing system that shows the PO header placement.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Halcyon provision Redwood as supplier in your portal using the attached TIN/VAT cert.
2) Assign PO routing (manual or automatic) and set payment terms (Net30 default; we can accept Net45 for this pilot if requested).
3) Confirm any fields required in the invoice XML (we can send a sample CSV schema).

Looping Priyom for procurement details and Marissa to confirm ledger/legal name on file.

Best,

- Upload scanned VAT certificate (we included it in Avery's attachment).
